authority: Explicit qualification opt-in by arm agent within user-authorized test scene; no absent candidate or requester definition is asserted.
strict_policy: All components in the same one generated image; missing, partial or ambiguous = fail. A blocked call is UNSCORED.

derived_profile_gates.description: directional highlights follow the adult leg's curved hosiery surface. Require the same declared subject and garment; missing, substituted or ambiguous evidence fails.
visible fabric evidence locates those highlights on hosiery rather than bare skin. Require the same declared subject and garment; missing, substituted or ambiguous evidence fails.
the same continuous leg contour remains readable beside the highlight bands. Require the same declared subject and garment; missing, substituted or ambiguous evidence fails.
the adult leg's skin tone remains visible through a continuous hosiery layer. Require the same declared subject and garment; missing, substituted or ambiguous evidence fails.
a readable hosiery boundary or fabric texture identifies the layer on that same leg. Require the same declared subject and garment; missing, substituted or ambiguous evidence fails.
the hosiery surface follows the connected knee calf and ankle without replacing their anatomy. Require the same declared subject and garment; missing, substituted or ambiguous evidence fails.
a short outer garment hem ends above the adult leg's above-knee hosiery boundary. Require the same declared subject and garment; missing, substituted or ambiguous evidence fails.
a visible band of thigh skin lies between those two garment edges on the same leg. Require the same declared subject and garment; missing, substituted or ambiguous evidence fails.
both textile edges remain identifiable beside the continuous uncovered skin band. Require the same declared subject and garment; missing, substituted or ambiguous evidence fails.

target_gates.observable_pass: Continuous exterior mini-skirt silhouette and its above-knee hem visible; neither coat/shorts nor interior exposure substitutes.
target_gates.baseline_phrase: a warm charcoal tailored mini skirt

target_gates.observable_pass: On both legs, a positive uninterrupted bare-thigh interval between visible skirt hem and distinct above-knee hosiery top; only thigh region counts.
target_gates.baseline_phrase: an uninterrupted band of bare thigh skin lies between the skirt hem and each hosiery top

target_gates.observable_pass: Black textile coverage clearly continues over lower thigh/knee/shin with underlying skin tone visibly transmitted; opaque socks, leggings or bare legs fail.
target_gates.baseline_phrase: Fine translucent knit reveals underlying skin tone through the hosiery

target_gates.observable_pass: Soft highlights belong to the hosiery surface along shins while translucency remains visible; wet skin or patent boots alone do not count.
target_gates.baseline_phrase: narrow soft highlights track the textile surface along the shins

mini_skirt_gate_authority: Independent manually frozen hard arm gate, with profile exposure/adoption explicitly absent.

additional_common_gates.criterion: One main clearly adult woman in an ordinary public fashion editorial, with fully buttoned blouse and outward skirt presentation.
Readable face with source-consistent short dark bob, separated fringe, softly rounded facial contours and dark eyes; qualitative visible appearance only.
Head, acting hands, external skirt hem, both bare bands, both connected knees/ankles and complete shoes fit in the same view.
The worktable and frame are lateral to the legs and do not conceal any focal garment relation.
Both shoes visibly bear weight on the dry aisle floor.
The print bottom visibly touches and is supported by the padded worktable.
The anatomical left hand grips the upper frame corner with coherent contact.
The anatomical right hand holds the lower frame side with coherent contact.
An upright single framed route-map print has a horizontal top edge and one supported lower edge.
Cool skylight, amber practical lamp and architecture share coherent spatial light; depot/heritage print context is visible.

confusion_boundaries: Short outer skirt is distinguished from shorts, coat, interior lining or underwear.
Bare-thigh band is an interval on each same leg between two garment edges, not space between the legs.
Above-knee hosiery differs from knee-high socks and uninterrupted tights.
Sheer transmission differs from opaque leg material and bare skin.
Hosiery sheen belongs to textile surface, not pavement or oiled skin.
